parameters.query:
insert into leads_bemestar (nome, telefone, empresa, cidade, prazo, itens, itens_hash, origem, utms, ip)
select $1, nullif($2, ''), $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7, $8, $9::jsonb, $10
where $2 = '' or not exists (
  select 1 from leads_bemestar
  where telefone = $2 and itens_hash = $7 and created_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'
)
returning id, nome, telefone, empresa, cidade, prazo, itens, origem;
